blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats to cruise Table Rock Lake, dine at the waterfront restaurant, stay at cozy lodging near the shore, and shop at the general store for trip necessities. Boat slips are available in various sizes, including overnight slips on a first come, first serve basis. The marina offers a full range of services including boat sales and repair.
